About this event

THIS IS A STATE RUN COMPETITION, FOR STATE POINTS

En garde! Whether you’re dialing in your game for AFC3 or looking to test your blade against the state’s best, this is your arena. ⚔️

Open to all fencers in the Senior / Open age group across Epee, Foil, and Sabre—come bring the intensity, fine-tune your strategy, and fight for glory on the piste!

📍 LOCATION & DETAILS

  • 📍 Venue: Sydney Academy of Fencing, Bldg 2/190 Bourke Rd, Alexandria

  • 🏆 Category: Senior / Open (All Weapons – Men’s & Women’s)

  • 🎟️ Eligibility: Open to everyone! (Ideal warm-up for AFC3 competitors)

⏰ DRAFT EVENT SCHEDULE

(Nominal times subject to final numbers)

  • 🤺 Men's & Women's Epee: 9:00 AM – 3:00 PM

  • ⚔️ Men's & Women's Foil: 11:00 AM – 5:00 PM

  • 🤺 Men's & Women's Sabre: 3:00 PM – 6:00 PM

🚨 DON'T MISS THE EARLY BIRD!

Save on your entry fee before prices rise! ⌛ Early Bird Deadline: Monday, 9th November @ 11:59 PM

Lock in your spot, sharpen your weapons, and get ready for an unforgettable day of high-stakes fencing! ⚡️💥
